title: CSD: Common-Support Distillation for Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.28895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-tokenizer logits distillation enables knowledge transfer across model families, allowing students to learn from stronger or more specialized teachers. However, differences in vocabulary and segmentation make teacher and student next-token distributions difficult to align. Existing logits-based methods are easy to integrate into standard distillation pipelines, but often rely on restrictive heuristics or tokenizer-pair-specific choices. They may restrict supervision to shared vocabulary subsets, require manually selecting different objectives for different tokenizer pairs, or match only the observed chunk and its complement rather than individual alternative continuations. We introduce Common-Support Distillation (CSD), a unified logits-based framework that constructs a shared support between the teacher and student at each aligned input chunk and matches the induced distributions with a single objective. translated_title: CSD：面向跨分词器知识迁移的公共支撑集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 跨分词器的logits蒸馏能够实现跨模型族的知识迁移，使学生模型能够从更强或更专精的教师模型中学习。然而，词表和分词方式的差异使得教师模型和学生模型的下一词元分布难以对齐。现有的基于logits的方法虽然易于集成到标准蒸馏流程中，但通常依赖于限制性的启发式方法或针对特定分词器对的选择。这些方法可能将监督限制在共享词表的子集上，需要为不同的分词器对手动选择不同的目标函数，或者仅匹配观察到的分块及其补集，而非逐个匹配备选的续写结果。我们提出了公共支撑集蒸馏，这是一个统一的基于logits的框架，它在每个对齐的输入分块处构建教师和学生模型之间的共享支撑集，并通过单一目标函数来匹配由此导出的分布。对于一对一的对齐情形，（摘要内容在此处被截断）
